moisture.notCoveredSlow: Housing company property insurance does not cover gradual damage such as rust or mould (FINE; rent-rules.json leaks.whoInsuresWhat).
moisture.certificateStatesCondition: The manager's certificate must state what the company knows about the condition of the buildings and of this flat (AOYL 7:27 §).
moisture.tenantRentReduction: A tenant whose flat is not in the required condition is released from rent or pays a reasonably reduced rent, from when the landlord knew of the defect (481/1995, 23 § 2 mom).
moisture.tenantHealthHazard: A tenant may cancel the lease if using the flat is an obvious health hazard (481/1995, 63 § 1 mom).

companyLoans.brochure: The sales brochure must state decided or otherwise certain major repairs and improvements, with an estimate of their timing and cost to the buyer (VNa 130/2001, 8 § 1 mom. 14–15 kohta).

conditionSurvey.agm: Each annual general meeting must receive the board's written report on maintenance needed in the next five years (AOYL 6:3 §). A longer-term plan (PTS) is common, but the Act does not require one.
